children: Vikramjeet Singh Sodhi disclosed beneficial ownership of 49.8% of Canagold Resources Ltd. through Sun Valley Investments AG and Goldlogic Corp. The Schedule 13D, filed on Oct. 13, 2026, details recent purchases in September and consolidates his control across affiliated entities. The sizable position sits just below a majority and underscores his central role in the company’s shareholder base.

Sodhi holds the shares for investment purposes and may consider taking part in future financings by Canagold Resources. He stated that the group "do not presently intend to increase their aggregate beneficial ownership to 50% or more" of the outstanding common shares.

The filing notes no plans for board changes, mergers, or other corporate actions at this time. While SVI AG could join future capital raises, Sodhi emphasized that current intentions stop short of seeking majority control.

Vikramjeet Singh Sodhi is a Grenadian investor who controls Sun Valley Investments AG and related holding companies. He manages these entities through a layered structure that includes Lucent Earth Foundation and Value Associates, LLC, and he directs all voting and investment decisions. He focuses on long-term, control-aware investments in smaller public companies and often participates in primary financings.
